from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,statistics,os,shutil
root=Path('/home/andrew-peterson/.codex/worktrees/stdlib-foundation/laniusc');p=root/'tests/fixtures/stdlib_compiler_state/complete-callable-owners'
def read(name):return json.loads((p/name).read_text())
def save(name,v):(p/name).write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n')
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
h=read('frozen-sources.json');changed=[f for f,v in h.items() if not (root/f).is_file() or sha(root/f)!=v];assert not changed,changed
suites={}
for name,count in [('library',20),('native',5)]:
 d=read(name+'.json');assert d['exit_code']==0 and d['frozen_sources_unchanged'] and len(d['passed'])==count,d;suites[name]=count
comparisons={}
for directory in ['performance-contracts','performance-ordinary']:
 runs=[json.loads(f.read_text()) for f in sorted((p/directory).glob('[0-3]-*.json'))]
 assert len(runs)==4 and all(r['exit_code']==0 and r['output_verified'] and r['sources_unchanged'] and r['shader_link_restored'] and len(r['samples_ms'])==10 for r in runs)
 medians={v:statistics.median([t for r in runs if r['version']==v for t in r['samples_ms']]) for v in ['baseline','current']}
 c={'runs':runs,'pooled_median_ms':medians,'change_percent':100*(medians['current']/medians['baseline']-1),'method':'Existing stdlib_gpu_perf; exact previous checkpoint binary/shaders vs frozen current binary/shaders; ABBA; 3 warmups and 10 measured entry rebuilds per run; output verification after every run.','limits':['Two focused workloads; no cross-compiler or canonical 1MB claim.','Cold driver preparation excluded from warm measurements.','Observed changes do not establish causality without further investigation.']}
 save(directory+'/comparison.json',c);comparisons[directory]={k:v for k,v in c.items() if k!='runs'}
(p/'final-sources.json').write_bytes((p/'frozen-sources.json').read_bytes())
shaders=(root/'target/stdlib-perf/build/laniusc-shader-artifacts/release/shaders').resolve()
shader_hashes={str(f.relative_to(shaders)):sha(f) for f in sorted(shaders.rglob('*')) if f.is_file()}
save('current-shader-hashes.json',shader_hashes)
manifest={'status':'25 selected correctness checks pass; complete executable callable ownership and normalized body identity verified','suites':suites,'source_files':len(h),'source_snapshot':'final-sources.json','shader_files':len(shader_hashes),'shader_snapshot':'current-shader-hashes.json','frozen_sources_unchanged':True,'performance':comparisons,'initial_attempts':['First library build failed due to relative CARGO_TARGET_DIR generated include paths; rerunning with absolute path succeeded.','First library run passed19/20. The new test incorrectly equated main body offset with startup-wrapper entry offset. Callable identity passed. Replaced the incorrect equality with entry presence; reran the focused suite.'],'execution_target':'Physical GPU executes the compiler. Emitted user programs execute as x86_64 Linux ELF. User-program GPU execution not established.','limits':['Program-wide catalog coherence, trait implementation selection, retained proof validation and imported replay authorization remain unfinished.','This checkpoint adds callable ownership; it does not satisfy trait obligations.']}
save('verification.json',manifest)
for path,name in [('/tmp/lanius-owner-verify.py','verification-runner.txt'),('/tmp/lanius-owner-perf.py','performance-runner.txt'),('/tmp/lanius-owner-finish.py','finish-runner.txt')]: (p/name).write_bytes(Path(path).read_bytes())
baseline=root/'target/complete-callable-owner-baseline';assert not baseline.exists();baseline.mkdir()
binary=root/'target/stdlib-perf/build/release/examples/stdlib_gpu_perf';os.link(binary,baseline/'stdlib_gpu_perf');shutil.copytree(shaders,baseline/'shaders')
save('completed-baseline.json',{'binary':str(baseline/'stdlib_gpu_perf'),'binary_sha256':sha(binary),'shaders':str(baseline/'shaders'),'shader_hashes':'current-shader-hashes.json'})
print(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
